title: Segment Activation: Cloud Storage Egress at Audience Scale

steps.prompt: Marketing activates a 20-million-profile segment to Amazon S3 every morning for ad platforms. The design must avoid CRM API ceilings and keep egress operationally simple. Which activation pattern fits?

options.label: Data 360 cloud storage activation target exporting compressed Parquet/CSV directly to the S3 bucket
options.rationale: Cloud storage activation is built for high-volume parallel object egress to destinations like S3, avoiding per-row CRM API paths while keeping the activation governed inside Data 360.

options.label: Apex trigger issuing millions of individual S3 REST callouts as Contacts update
options.rationale: Synchronous/near-synchronous Apex callouts cannot egress 20M profiles without exhausting API, CPU, and callout governors.

options.label: Export the full audience as a CSV email attachment to the campaign ops alias
options.rationale: Email attachments hit size limits and create uncontrolled PII copies outside governed activation channels — a Trust and Reliability failure.
